metadata.title: SignBridge Isolated ASL Word-Sign Dataset Research & Selection Report
metadata.author: SignBridge Machine Learning & Computer Vision Subsystem
metadata.objective: Select legitimate, reproducible, license-compliant isolated ASL dataset for word-sign recognition

WLASL.organization: University of Sydney, ByteDance AI Lab
WLASL.reference_paper: Word-level Deep Sign Language Recognition from Video: A New Large-scale Dataset and Methods (WACV 2020)
WLASL.redistribution_terms: Raw third-party video scraping requires download scripts or permitted academic mirror; bundling restricted copyrighted raw videos in git repositories is prohibited
WLASL.video_quality: Webcam & studio educational quality, front-facing signers, varying resolutions (typically 480p/720p)
WLASL.reproducibility: High (official JSON annotations, train/val/test splits, Kaggle and HuggingFace mirrors)
WLASL.pipeline_compatibility: Excellent (OpenCV mp4 decoding, MediaPipe front-facing tracking, 1-2 hand support)
WLASL.preprocessing_required: Landmark extraction, temporal sequence resampling (T=20), coordinate normalization
pros: Standard academic benchmark cited in 200+ peer-reviewed papers
Official WLASL-100 subset provides balanced 100-class benchmark
Isolated signs with start/end frame boundaries provided
English gloss labels match direct concept translation
Zero authentication required for metadata and open academic mirrors
cons: Original scraping sources have some dead links over time (mitigated by processed academic mirrors)
Third-party copyright requires user/first-run acquisition rather than git bundling

ASL_Citizen.full_name: ASL Citizen: A Community-Sourced Dataset for Isolated Sign Language Recognition
ASL_Citizen.reference_paper: ASL Citizen: A Community-Sourced Dataset for Advancing Isolated Sign Language Recognition (NeurIPS 2023 Datasets & Benchmarks)
ASL_Citizen.license: Microsoft Research Open Data / Custom Non-commercial Research License
ASL_Citizen.redistribution_terms: Allowed for academic and non-commercial research use; download hosted by Microsoft Download Center
ASL_Citizen.video_quality: Real-world webcam recordings crowdsourced with informed consent from Deaf and Hard of Hearing signers
ASL_Citizen.pipeline_compatibility: High (standard mp4 format, isolated signs, diverse environments)
ASL_Citizen.preprocessing_required: Requires downloading massive 46 GB archive unless filtered by gloss metadata
pros: Crowdsourced from Deaf/HH community members with full informed consent
High variance in lighting, cameras, and backgrounds ensures model generalization
cons: Massive full archive (46 GB) is prohibitive for direct local installation without filtering

MS_ASL.full_name: MS-ASL: A Large-Scale Machine Reading and Sign Language Recognition Dataset
MS_ASL.reference_paper: MS-ASL: A Large-Scale Machine Reading and Sign Language Recognition Dataset (BMVC 2019)
MS_ASL.redistribution_terms: YouTube video segments; users must download via YouTube URLs
MS_ASL.video_quality: YouTube-sourced videos, variable compression, varying framing
MS_ASL.reproducibility: Low to Moderate (approx 35% of original YouTube video URLs are broken or removed)
MS_ASL.pipeline_compatibility: Moderate (variable bounding boxes and YouTube video artifacts)
MS_ASL.preprocessing_required: Video clipping from start/end timestamps, bounding box cropping
pros: Diverse signers and real-world YouTube conditions
cons: Severe URL bit-rot: > 30% of videos cannot be downloaded today
Complex timestamp trimming and cropping required
Low reproducibility for student and academic deployment

comparative_analysis.rationale: WLASL-100 provides the optimal balance of standard academic benchmarking, reproducibility, complete isolated sign coverage, and manageable download size (~1.4 GB for 100 classes vs 46 GB for ASL Citizen). ASL Citizen serves as a secondary lexicon validation reference. MS-ASL is rejected due to severe YouTube link decay (>35%).
comparative_analysis.license_compliance_strategy: Under C-UDA 1.0, academic educational use is fully permitted. To strictly honor copyright and redistribution boundaries, large video archives will not be committed to Git. Instead, a clean automated acquisition script downloads the target subset directly from approved academic sources, while curated, license-cleared CC-BY / Public Domain demo sample videos are provided with full attribution metadata in datasets/samples/word_signs/.
